title: Viva Engage: network analytics gets custom date ranges, faster refresh and people-manager filters
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing requirements and documented admin control are supported. It distinguishes existing analytics controls from the planned enhancements and correctly leaves their default, manager-data requirements and separate controls unconfirmed.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Viva Engage Premium is bundled with the Employee Communications and Communities licence.
claims.quote: Viva Engage Premium, which is bundled with the Viva Suite and Employee Communications and Communities (C&C) licenses.

claims.claim: The analytics page requires at least 50% of network users to have Viva Suite, Employee Communications and Communities or Viva Engage premium licences for dashboard visibility.
claims.quote: For a visible Network analytics dashboard, at least 50% of the network’s users must be licensed for Viva Suite or Employee Communications and Communities, or for the Viva Engage premium license.

claims.claim: The filtering page's dashboard licence-share requirement lists Viva Suite and Employee Communications and Communities, unlike the analytics page's additional premium licence option.
claims.quote: If less than 50% of your network’s users are licensed for Viva Suite or Employee Communications and Communities, the Network Analytics dashboard is unavailable.

claims.claim: Organizational Data Filters is a Viva Engage premium feature.
claims.quote: Organizational Data Filters is a Viva Engage premium feature

claims.claim: The documented All filters panel offers Date Range, Country, Department and Job Title.
claims.quote:
Select the All filters button at the top of the Network analytics dashboard to open the side panel. The available categories for filtering are:
- Date Range
- Country
- Department
- Job Title

claims.claim: Organizational Data Filters apply to Network Analytics metrics except retention, engagement benchmarks, themes and sentiment.
claims.quote: Organizational Data Filters apply to all Network Analytics metrics except for retention, engagement benchmarks, themes, and sentiment.

claims.claim: Learn does not yet describe the new manager filters or custom date ranges; their description rests on the roadmap.
claims.quote: Searched: "Viva Engage" "people-manager" "filters"; "Viva Engage" "custom date ranges" "enable". Read Learn analytics and analytics-organizational-data-filtering in full; results described current Engage filters or other Viva products.

claims.claim: Viva Engage obtains organisational attributes from the network's Entra ID directory by default.
claims.quote: By default, Viva Engage pulls organizational attributes for each user from a network’s Entra ID directory.

claims.claim: A Microsoft 365 admin can alternatively upload organisational profile data in a CSV through the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: a Microsoft 365 Admin can upload a CSV file containing user profiles via the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

claims.claim: The organisational data CSV must include the Microsoft_PersonEmail column.
claims.quote: For Organizational Data Filters, the CSV file must include the Microsoft_PersonEmail attribute as a column header.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance controls
claims.claim: Viva Engage does not clean uploaded organisational data, so data-quality checks and corrections belong at its sources.
claims.quote: Viva Engage doesn't perform data cleaning or data processing, so be sure to review your data before you upload.

claims.claim: Today's organisational filters group attributes with fewer than 10 users under Other to protect privacy.
claims.quote: Any attributes with fewer than 10 users are also grouped into the Other category to maintain user privacy.

claims.claim: The existing filter dropdown includes Other and Unspecified categories.
claims.quote: The Other and Unspecified categories appear at the bottom of the dropdown to provide context of their data quality and distribution, but we don't calculate metrics for those categories.

claims.claim: Verified Admins, Network Admins and Corporate Communicators can use analytics filtering in Network Analytics.
claims.quote: Verified Admins, Network Admins, and Corporate Communicators can use analytics filtering in the Network Analytics dashboard.

claims.claim: Verified Admins and Network Admins can manage Organizational Data Filters in the Viva Engage admin center.
claims.quote: Verified Admins and Network Admins can manage Organizational Data Filters in the Viva Engage Admin Center.

claims.claim: The control is at Viva Engage admin center > Setup & Configuration > Analytics and AI > Network Analytics > Organizational Data Filters.
claims.quote:
On the Setup & Configuration tab, select Analytics and AI.
Go to the Network Analytics section to access the Organizational Data Filters toggle.

claims.claim: The network-level Organizational Data Filters toggle controls whether users can filter analytics by employee attributes.
claims.quote: Go to the Network Analytics section to access the Organizational Data Filters toggle. When you enable it, users can filter their analytics by employee attributes.

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell operation for the Organizational Data Filters toggle is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Viva Engage" "Organizational Data Filters" "PowerShell"; "Viva Engage" "Organizational Data Filters" "API" "beta". Read filtering and Graph engagement-api-overview v1.0/beta; no toggle-setting operation.

claims.claim: A separate admin UI or automation switch for manager filters, custom date ranges or faster refresh is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage network analytics people manager filters privacy protections manager attribute role switch refresh enable. Read Learn filtering, analytics and Graph engagement-api-overview v1.0/beta; no separate switch.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether the existing Organizational Data Filters toggle governs the new enhancements.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage network analytics people manager filters custom date ranges default enabled privacy reporting hierarchy attribute. Read analytics-organizational-data-filtering and analytics; no passage links the toggle to the enhancements.

claims.claim: The existing Organizational Data Filters feature is enabled by default in a network.
claims.quote: By default, the Organizational Data Filters feature is enabled in your network.

claims.claim: Privacy protections specific to the new manager filters, including whether the existing minimum-of-10 grouping applies, are not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage network analytics people manager filters privacy protections manager attribute role switch refresh enable. Read filtering and analytics; privacy grouping addresses existing attributes, not manager filters.

claims.claim: The attribute used by the new manager filters and any extra CSV columns they require are not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Viva Engage" "people-manager" "filters". Read analytics and analytics-organizational-data-filtering, including upload requirements; no manager-filter attribute or extra CSV columns documented.

claims.claim: No new role is described for the enhancements.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage network analytics people manager filters privacy protections manager attribute role switch refresh enable. Read roadmap, filtering, analytics and Graph engagement overview; no new role for these enhancements.

claims.claim: Most existing analytics data refreshes every 24 hours.
claims.quote: Most analytics data refreshes every 24 hours.

claims.claim: Existing conversation analytics update in near real time.
claims.quote: Conversation and community analytics update in near real time.

claims.claim: Existing community analytics update in near real time.
claims.quote: Conversation and community analytics update in near real time.

claims.claim: The roadmap names no new data source for the enhancements.
claims.quote: network analytics includes custom date ranges, faster activity data refreshes, updated dashboard and metric table designs, expanded organizational filters with search, and new people-manager filters for viewing direct reports or full reporting hierarchies.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap describes reporting views and filters, not an autonomous action on a user's behalf.
claims.quote: These enhancements make it easier to explore trends, understand audience engagement, and measure communications impact across the network.

claims.claim: The employee-retention documentation restricts the Network Analytics dashboard to Engage network admins and corporate communicators.
claims.quote: Only Engage network admins and corporate communicators have access to the Network Analytics dashboard.

claims.claim: No separate price or meter for these enhancements is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage network analytics enhancements people manager filters licensing price meter. Opened Learn analytics, analytics-organizational-data-filtering and microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-viva/pricing; found product licences but no enhancement-specific price or meter.
